investigations.name: mgen
investigations.title: viva-mGen: reproducing the Karr 2012 M. genitalium whole-cell model, one study per figure
investigations.description:
Seven studies, one per figure of Karr et al. 2012, all built on the same
viva-native reproduction of the whole-cell model (package viva_mgen). The
metabolic engine is the real published Suthers 2009 iPS189 reconstruction
(351 reactions, 126 genes) solved with cobra; mass, cell-cycle, and
composition constants are taken verbatim from the original model's fitted
parameters. Fidelity is honest and per-study: Fig 2 (growth/composition) and
Fig 6 (metabolic-gene essentiality) are full-fidelity; Fig 4 is a genuine but
reduced mechanism; Fig 1/3/5/7 are representative/reduced. Each study has a
real expected_behavior/behavior_tests pair, a canonical sims/run.py that
drives the composite and renders an interactive visualization, and a run
recorded in the workspace .pbg/runs.jsonl. See each study's own fidelity note
and caveats. This is NOT the full 28-submodel model (chromosome occupancy,
128-cell population distributions, and the 3,011-strain deletion scan are out
of scope) — it is a reduced-but-genuine core, faithful where it claims to be.
